name: Ezbon
overview: Ezbon was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Bela. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture offers no additional notes or distinguishing attributes about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Ezbon appears only once in Scripture and is presented as a proper name without any given meaning or divine origin noted. Therefore, it is simply recognized as the personal name of this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Ezbon is explicitly identified as the son of Bela, linking him directly to this Benjaminite lineage. Scripture does not record any further family relationships for Ezbon beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ezbon's significance lies in his role as a genealogical figure within the tribe of Benjamin, serving to document the lineage of Bela. While not highlighted for specific deeds or roles, his mention contributes to the biblical record of Israel's tribal families, which is important for understanding God's providential preservation of His people.
